name: Pumpkin
author: kubisgg@users.noreply.github.com
description: Minecraft server written in Rust with native Java and experimental Bedrock support. Pumpkin is under heavy development. Expect incomplete features and bugs.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

cd /mnt/server

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) PUMPKIN_ARCH=X64 ;;
    aarch64|arm64) PUMPKIN_ARCH=ARM64 ;;
    *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $(uname -m)"; exit 1 ;;
esac

BINARY_NAME="pumpkin-${PUMPKIN_ARCH}-Linux-musl"
RELEASE_API="https://api.github.com/repos/Pumpkin-MC/Pumpkin/releases"
if [ "${PUMPKIN_VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
    RELEASE_API="${RELEASE_API}/latest"
else
    RELEASE_TAG=$(printf '%s' "${PUMPKIN_VERSION}" | jq -sRr @uri)
    RELEASE_API="${RELEASE_API}/tags/${RELEASE_TAG}"
fi

RELEASE_JSON=$(curl -fsSL "${RELEASE_API}")
DOWNLOAD_URL=$(printf '%s' "${RELEASE_JSON}" | jq -er --arg name "${BINARY_NAME}" '.assets[] | select(.name == $name) | .browser_download_url')
curl -fSL --retry 3 "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" -o pumpkin.download
chmod +x pumpkin.download
mv -f pumpkin.download pumpkin

if [ ! -f pumpkin.toml ]; then
    cat > pumpkin.toml <<'CONFIG'
[commands]
use_console = true
use_tty = false

[networking.java]
enabled = true
address = "0.0.0.0:25565"

[networking.bedrock]
enabled = false

[networking.bedrock.nethernet]
enabled = true
address = "0.0.0.0:19132"
CONFIG
fi

echo "Pumpkin installation completed."

variables.description: Release to download when installing or reinstalling. Use latest for the latest stable release, nightly for development builds, or an exact GitHub release tag. Reinstall to apply a version change.

variables.name: Bedrock port
variables.description: Set to 0 to disable Bedrock. A nonzero port automatically enables it on that port. Assign a separate allocation with both TCP and UDP, then restart to apply changes.
